goal: Allow libbitcoinkernel users to validate individual blocks without maintaining a full local UTXO set
Enables lightweight clients and custom indexers to independently validate blocks using supplied coins
agreement: Disputed over cache poisoning, release assertion crashes, and caller determinism
Contested objection: script cache poisoning allows forged coins to connect an invalid block (w0xlt)
Contested objection: assertion crash in release builds if coin confirmation height is invalid (w0xlt)
Contested objection: lookup callback allows non-deterministic lookups and loses UTXO changes (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: blocks under assumevalid skip script checks during validation (nervana21)

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it eliminates the storage burden of a full chainstate for external library consumers
Unblocks lightweight nodes and custom indexers that only need to check specific blocks

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it expands verification reach to callers with custom or external coin storage
Enables flexible validation workflows without altering node chainstate requirements
